feedback.title: Feetech force feedback
feedback.hint: One-way wall: resist closing, release on opening; current limit 150.
feedback.angleHint: Connection sets the current angle to 50 mm. One-way stops at 0 and 50 mm allow free motion back into the travel range. Turn angle control off for auto grasp.
feedback.help.force_gain: Scales the simulated finger contact forces.
feedback.help.angle_scale: Servo degrees to joint7 linear travel; total finger separation depends on the mechanism.
feedback.help.max_raw: Actual nonnegative current register limit, always 0–150. Target position sets the wall direction.
feedback.help.stiffness: Deeper penetration beyond the fixed contact boundary permits stronger resistance.
feedback.help.full_scale_n: Contact force that produces a base output of 100 before gain.
feedback.help.contact_on_n: A finger enters contact above this threshold.
feedback.help.contact_off_n: Must be lower than the on threshold to provide hysteresis.
feedback.help.grip_confirm_ms: Both fingers must touch the same object for this long.
feedback.help.touch_cap_raw: Output cap before a stable grip is confirmed.
feedback.help.opening_fraction: Remaining resistance during intentional opening; 0 releases completely.
feedback.help.slip_distance_mm: Object displacement relative to the gripper after a stable grip.
feedback.help.slip_confirm_ms: Slip displacement or contact loss must persist for this long.
feedback.help.slip_pulse_raw: Optional 80 ms cue when slipping begins; disabled by default.
feedback.help.slew_raw_s: Maximum output change per second; zero output releases immediately.
feedback.live: Settings apply live and are saved in this browser.
feedback.saved: Settings are saved in this browser and apply on connection.
feedback.invalid: Invalid settings: check bounds, off < on, and deadband < force reference.
feedback.noPorts: No serial ports found. Connect USB, then refresh.
feedback.portHint: Choose the servo port, then connect. Disconnect before switching ports.
feedback.portError: Could not list ports: {error}. Start the bridge, then refresh.
feedback.help.resistance_speed: Limits return to the fixed boundary; default 2 steps ≈ 8.78°/s. Opening disables output.
feedback.help.wall_hold_raw: Added during valid contact, bounded by the touch cap and overall current limit.
feedback.help.release_angle_deg: Opening displacement from the deepest closing position that immediately disables output. The free side is always released.
feedback.help.rearm_angle_deg: Required closing displacement after release; resistance resumes only at the fixed boundary.
feedback.angleError: Last angle read failure: {error}; servo status: {status}{details}
